run_remote_evaluator: run the RemoteEvaluator class to send source segments and receive predictions from a remote server via HTTP
create_demo_remote: create a DemoRemote instance that records live audio, applies VAD, and sends speech segments to a remote evaluator
send_source_segment: send a source segment to a remote server endpoint using HTTP PUT with JSON-serialized segment data
receive_prediction: receive a prediction segment from a remote server endpoint using HTTP GET and parse JSON response
convert_pcm_to_float: convert 16-bit PCM byte data to normalized float32 audio samples using byte_to_float helper function
